raw_posts.name: Weave Router 2.0
raw_posts.description: Use Claude models in Codex and GPT models in Claude Code on your existing plans, routed to whichever has quota left. Weave Router 2.0 routes each coding agent request to the cheapest model that can get it right. On Terminal-Bench 4.0 and SWE-Atlas it matches GPT-6 Astra at half the cost, 2x faster. Powered by a new classifier that scores task complexity and cache-aware switching that only moves when savings beat the rebuild cost.

raw_posts.name: Appwrite 2.0
raw_posts.tagline: The open-source cloud for agents and developers
raw_posts.description: Appwrite 2.0 is the second major generation of the platform. It replaces the engine underneath, rebuilds the Console on top, and expands what a project can hold: relational, schemaless, and vector data, native PostgreSQL and MySQL engines, S3-addressable storage, an OAuth 2.1 and OIDC-compliant identity provider, and the network layer in front of all of it.

raw_posts.name: Toki Coordination
raw_posts.tagline: Your personal assistant to schedule + follow up on meetings
raw_posts.description: Stop wasting 3 days scheduling a 30 minute group meeting or starting over every time someone cancels. Like a real executive assistant, Toki will email attendees, negotiate a time that works for everyone, follow up if needed, and send out invites. Toki will also help protect your time, architect your schedule, remember your preferences, and help you prioritize your most important tasks and urgent deadlines. And instead of paying tens of thousands, it's now free.

raw_posts.name: CAT ME app
raw_posts.tagline: See yourself or your friends as cats
raw_posts.description: The Cat Me app turns a photo of a person into their very own cat lookalike!  It’s simple and purr-fect:  1. Snap a picture of yourself or a friend. 2. Create a unique cat that matches their look and personality.  3. Share your new kitty with your crew. Each Purrtrait is generated by AI based on the original photo, transforming human features, expressions, hairstyles, and accessories into a one-of-a-kind cat. What would you look like as a cat?

raw_posts.description: Thread is an AI journal and second brain for capturing thoughts, ideas, notes, and voice recordings. It automatically connects related memories, finds patterns in your thinking, and turns scattered ideas into meaningful threads. Capture anything in seconds, rediscover what matters, and turn your thoughts into actionable ideas with a private AI-powered memory system.

raw_posts.name: Twigg
raw_posts.tagline: The context layer you never have to build
raw_posts.description: Twigg is a stateful API for calling LLMs. Instead of rebuilding and resending your whole conversation on every request, you create a chat once and send only the next event. Twigg holds the state: it fits context to the target model's schema, compacts or truncates when it runs long, and routes the call. Control tool schemas, system prompts and context windows from the dashboard, and track usage and billing. Build anything from personal agents to enterprise apps. You never manage context again.
